test.name: JOURNEY-03 in the app: PostgreSQL 18 beside 17 on this Mac

expected: JOURNEY-03 in the app: PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 install through the Get button from the xtask cache without network, pg17-dev stays Ready while 18.6 installs, New Instance offers both runtimes, pg18-dev starts from 18.6, the Instances Version column shows 17.11 and 18.6, and the connection copied from the Summary tab of pg18-dev reaches psql of runtime 18 with SELECT version() containing 18.6
steps: follow docs/manual.md section T (JOURNEY-03: PostgreSQL 17 dan 18 di aplikasi) on the commit this record was made on, with a clean tree; it builds with `cargo build -p stacklyd -p stackly-cli` and `cargo xtask build-app`, builds a throwaway catalog with `cargo xtask catalog build`, starts stacklyd on a mktemp root with STACKLY_CATALOG_DIR, and copies the two artifacts from ~/Library/Caches/dev.stackly.xtask/runtime/ (sha256 04b1eff1... for 17.11 and 88bb7533... for 18.6) into <root>/cache/downloads/ so Get never touches the network; if either file is missing the status is BLOCKED and nothing is downloaded without your approval

Catalog, PostgreSQL: Get on 17.11, expect Installed in about 10 s and one PostgreSQL 17.11 row on Runtimes; create and start pg17-dev from New Instance (Runtime offers only PostgreSQL 17.11), expect Ready, and write down its PID from `stackly instance get`

with pg17-dev Ready, Get on 18.6; expect the pg17-dev row to stay Ready on Instances for the whole install and `stackly instance get` to show the same PID and start time afterwards; Runtimes shows two rows (17.11 and 18.6)
New Instance again: the Runtime list holds PostgreSQL 17.11 and PostgreSQL 18.6; create and start pg18-dev from 18.6 on a different port, expect Ready while pg17-dev stays Ready with the same PID
Instances with a wide window: Version column reads 17.11 for pg17-dev and 18.6 for pg18-dev, Endpoints shows two different ports; open pg18-dev, tab Summary shows its own endpoint and connection

Copy the connection string of pg18-dev (within 90 s run it): `<root>/data/runtimes/postgresql/18.6/.../bin/psql "$(pbpaste)" -Atc 'SELECT version()'` prints a line containing PostgreSQL 18.6; the same for pg17-dev with the runtime 17.11 psql prints 17.11; `ps` shows two postmasters, one under each runtime folder

screenshots (Runtimes with both runtimes, New Instance sheet with the Runtime list open, Instances with the Version column, Summary tab of pg18-dev) are copied to evidence/manual/files/01a163bd-1573-774e-8367-c3db3d283798/

clean up as section T step 17 (stop both instances, quit the app, stop stacklyd, rm -rf the root and the catalog folder, check ps), then fill in this record: steps (note any change), actual, status (PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED with reason and owner), reviewer, finishedAt, and the Version fields as observed from `SHOW server_version`, then run `cargo xtask evidence check`
